# First Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}

# Identify spectral bands
bands <- names(df_clean_names) %>%
  str_subset("^band_\\d+$")

# Target variable
target <- "r6_nni_combined"

# Prepare dataset
df_eda <- df_clean_names %>%
  mutate(
    year = factor(year),
    stage = factor(stage,
                   levels = c("V8", "R1", "R2", "R5", "R6")),
    n_treatment = factor(n_treatment),
    study_field = factor(study_field),
    date = as.Date(date)
  )

# Separate by growth stage
stage_data <- split(df_eda, df_eda$stage)

# Example: access R1 dataset
df_r1 <- stage_data[["R1"]]
```


# Summarize NNI across crop stages

```{r}
nni_summary <- df_eda %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(r6_nni_combined)),
    mean = mean(r6_nni_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(r6_nni_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(r6_nni_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum = min(r6_nni_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(r6_nni_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv = 100 * sd / mean,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(nni_summary)
```

# Correlation between NNI and spectral bands

```{r}
# Correlation analysis by stage
cor_results <- map_dfr(names(stage_data), function(s) {

  d <- stage_data[[s]]

  map_dfr(bands, function(b) {

    tibble(
      stage = s,
      band = b,
      pearson = cor(
        d[[b]], d[[target]],
        method = "pearson",
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),
      spearman = cor(
        d[[b]], d[[target]],
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )
    )
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(
    band_number = as.numeric(str_remove(band, "band_"))
  )

# Top 10 bands for each stage
top_bands <- cor_results %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = abs(pearson),
    n = 10
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(top_bands)
```

# Feature selection using Elastic Net

```{r}


# Exploratory Elastic Net feature selection
selected_bands <- map_dfr(names(stage_data), function(s) {

  d <- stage_data[[s]] %>%
    drop_na(all_of(target))

  x <- as.matrix(d[, bands])
  y <- d[[target]]

  # Inner cross-validation for lambda selection
  set.seed(123)

  fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x, y,
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 5,
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  coefs <- as.matrix(
    coef(fit, s = "lambda.1se")
  )

  tibble(
    stage = s,
    band = rownames(coefs),
    coefficient = as.numeric(coefs[, 1])
  ) %>%
    filter(
      band != "(Intercept)",
      coefficient != 0
    )
})

print(selected_bands)
```

# Develop NNI prediction E_net models with LOOCV

```{r}

# Function for stage-specific LOOCV
run_loocv <- function(data, stage_name, alpha = 0.5) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) %>%
    select(all_of(c(target, bands))) %>%
    drop_na()

  x <- as.matrix(d[, bands])
  y <- d[[target]]

  n <- length(y)
  predictions <- numeric(n)

  # Outer LOOCV
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    x_train <- x[-i, , drop = FALSE]
    y_train <- y[-i]

    x_test <- x[i, , drop = FALSE]

    # Inner CV for hyperparameter selection
    set.seed(123 + i)

    fit <- cv.glmnet(
      x_train,
      y_train,
      alpha = alpha,
      nfolds = 5,
      standardize = TRUE
    )

    predictions[i] <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        fit,
        newx = x_test,
        s = "lambda.min"
      )
    )
  }

  tibble(
    stage = stage_name,
    observed = y,
    predicted = predictions
  )
}

# Run independent models for each crop stage
loocv_results <- map_dfr(
  names(stage_data),
  function(s) {
    run_loocv(stage_data[[s]], s)
  }
)
```

# Model Evaluations

```{r}
model_metrics <- loocv_results %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    R2 = 1 - sum((observed - predicted)^2) /
      sum((observed - mean(observed))^2),

    RMSE = sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)),

    MAE = mean(abs(observed - predicted)),

    Bias = mean(predicted - observed),

    RPD = sd(observed) /
      sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)),

    RPIQ = IQR(observed) /
      sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(model_metrics)
```

# For all models set the seed

```{r}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Avoid parallel-related reproducibility differences
options(mc.cores = 1)

# Import dataset
df <- df_clean_names
# Identify hyperspectral bands
bands <- names(df) %>%
  str_subset("^band_\\d+$")

# Response variable
target <- "r6_nni_combined"

# Define stages
stages <- c("V8", "R1", "R2", "R5", "R6")

# Prepare data
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(stage, levels = stages)
  )

stage_data <- split(df, df$stage)
```


```{r}
# Select bands for MLR without using test observations
select_mlr_bands <- function(x, y, k = 3) {

  correlations <- apply(
    x, 2,
    function(z) suppressWarnings(
      cor(z, y, use = "complete.obs")
    )
  )

  ranked <- names(sort(
    abs(correlations),
    decreasing = TRUE,
    na.last = NA
  ))

  selected <- character(0)

  for (b in ranked) {

    if (length(selected) == 0) {
      selected <- b
    } else {

      cor_with_selected <- abs(
        cor(x[[b]], x[, selected, drop = FALSE])
      )

      if (all(is.finite(cor_with_selected)) &&
          all(cor_with_selected < 0.95)) {
        selected <- c(selected, b)
      }
    }

    if (length(selected) == k) break
  }

  selected
}


# Run models with outer LOOCV
run_stage_models <- function(data, stage_name,
                             stage_index) {

  d <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(target, bands))) %>%
    drop_na()

  x <- d %>% select(all_of(bands))
  y <- d[[target]]

  n <- nrow(d)

  results <- vector("list", n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    # Reproducible random state for this iteration
    set.seed(123 + stage_index * 1000 + i)

    train_index <- setdiff(seq_len(n), i)

    x_train <- x[train_index, , drop = FALSE]
    x_test  <- x[i, , drop = FALSE]

    y_train <- y[train_index]

    # Internal cross-validation
    ctrl <- trainControl(
      method = "cv",
      number = 5,
      allowParallel = FALSE
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Model 1: Multiple Linear Regression
    # ---------------------------------

    mlr_bands <- select_mlr_bands(
      x_train, y_train, k = 3
    )

    mlr_train <- data.frame(
      NNI = y_train,
      x_train[, mlr_bands, drop = FALSE]
    )

    mlr_fit <- lm(NNI ~ ., data = mlr_train)

    pred_mlr <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        mlr_fit,
        newdata = x_test
      )
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Model 2: PCR
    # ---------------------------------

    pcr_grid <- expand.grid(
      ncomp = 1:min(10, nrow(x_train) - 3)
    )

    pcr_fit <- train(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "pcr",
      preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = pcr_grid,
      metric = "RMSE"
    )

    pred_pcr <- as.numeric(
      predict(pcr_fit, newdata = x_test)
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Model 3: PLSR
    # ---------------------------------

    pls_grid <- expand.grid(
      ncomp = 1:min(10, nrow(x_train) - 3)
    )

    pls_fit <- train(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "pls",
      preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = pls_grid,
      metric = "RMSE"
    )

    pred_pls <- as.numeric(
      predict(pls_fit, newdata = x_test)
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Model 4: Elastic Net
    # ---------------------------------

    en_grid <- expand.grid(
      alpha = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
      lambda = exp(seq(
        log(0.001),
        log(1),
        length.out = 8
      ))
    )

    en_fit <- train(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "glmnet",
      preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = en_grid,
      metric = "RMSE"
    )

    pred_en <- as.numeric(
      predict(en_fit, newdata = x_test)
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Model 5: Random Forest
    # ---------------------------------

    rf_grid <- expand.grid(
      mtry = unique(pmin(
        c(5, 15, 30),
        ncol(x_train)
      )),
      splitrule = "variance",
      min.node.size = 5
    )

    rf_fit <- train(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      method = "ranger",
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = rf_grid,
      num.trees = 300,
      num.threads = 1,
      importance = "permutation",
      metric = "RMSE"
    )

    pred_rf <- as.numeric(
      predict(rf_fit, newdata = x_test)
    )

    # ---------------------------------
    # Store held-out predictions
    # ---------------------------------

    results[[i]] <- tibble(
      stage = stage_name,
      observation = i,
      observed = y[i],
      MLR = pred_mlr,
      PCR = pred_pcr,
      PLSR = pred_pls,
      Elastic_Net = pred_en,
      Random_Forest = pred_rf
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

all_predictions <- map2_dfr(
  stages,
  seq_along(stages),
  function(s, j) {

    message("Running stage: ", s)

    run_stage_models(
      data = stage_data[[s]],
      stage_name = s,
      stage_index = j
    )
  }
)

# Convert to long format
predictions_long <- all_predictions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      MLR, PCR, PLSR,
      Elastic_Net, Random_Forest
    ),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "predicted"
  )

write_csv(
  predictions_long,
  "NNI_LOOCV_predictions.csv"
)
```

```{r}
model_performance <- predictions_long %>%
  group_by(stage, model) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    R2 = 1 -
      sum((observed - predicted)^2) /
      sum((observed - mean(observed))^2),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean((observed - predicted)^2)
    ),

    MAE = mean(
      abs(observed - predicted)
    ),

    Bias = mean(
      predicted - observed
    ),

    RPD = sd(observed) /
      sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)),

    RPIQ = IQR(observed) /
      sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)),

    nRMSE = 100 *
      sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)) /
      mean(observed),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(stage, RMSE)

print(model_performance)

write_csv(
  model_performance,
  "NNI_model_performance.csv"
)
```
